name: GhostInterview
description_en:
GhostInterview is a desktop interview copilot for coding, system design and object-oriented design. It combines live AI assistance with uploaded preparation material, optional collaboration with a user-invited helper and a later interview debrief. It is not a general repository development platform.

The site markets an overlay intended to be hidden from screen capture on supported setups. That is a vendor claim with platform conditions, not a verified guarantee. This profile evaluates the documented preparation and review workflow; no interview or recording was conducted.
description_zh:
GhostInterview 是覆盖编程、系统设计及面向对象设计的桌面面试辅助工具，结合实时AI辅助、上传准备资料、用户自行邀请协作者及后续面试复盘，并非通用仓库开发平台。

官网宣传覆盖层在受支持环境下不进入屏幕捕获，这属于附平台条件的厂商主张，不是已验证保证。本文核对文档中的准备及复盘流程，未进行面试或录制。

sections.title_en: Separate preparation, live input and debrief
sections.title_zh: 区分准备、实时输入及复盘
sections.en:
The product describes Knowledge Bases accepting TXT or Markdown, with selected passages available alongside a resume, job description and interview context. During a session, transcripts and screenshot context feed AI answers. Duo lets a user invite their own helper and choose what screen, audio and interview material to share; the service does not provide or match helpers.

For a permitted mock interview, use a public practice problem, inspect the proposed reasoning and verify complexity and edge cases yourself. A saved Interview Record can feed a debrief with preparation cards, but the site explicitly says it does not predict hiring decisions or grade individual technical answers. No outcome or accuracy claim is established here.
sections.zh:
产品说明Knowledge Bases接收TXT或Markdown，所选片段与简历、职位说明及面试上下文一起用于辅助。会话中转录及截图上下文用于AI回答。Duo允许用户自行邀请协作者并选择共享屏幕、音频及面试材料，服务不提供或匹配协作者。

获允许的模拟面试可用公开练习题，检查建议推理，并自行验证复杂度和边界情况。已存Interview Record可生成复盘及准备卡，但官网明确不预测录用结果或为单个技术答案评分。本文未证实结果或准确性主张。

sections.title_en: Platform and permission changes can break assumptions
sections.title_zh: 平台及权限变化会改变条件
sections.en:
The documentation lists macOS and Windows installers and directs users through installation, sign-in, permissions and a first session. It emphasizes checking the actual machine and platform before relying on a previous configuration. Its own documentation says unsupported setups have no universal invisibility guarantee.

Screen capture and audio contain information beyond a question prompt; confirm what is shared with the service and helper before using private material. No screen-sharing behavior, capture exclusion, transcription quality, data-retention policy or OS permission flow was tested. A stealth marketing label is not evidence of authorization to use assistance in a particular interview.
sections.zh:
文档列出macOS及Windows安装包，配置路径包括安装、登录、权限及首个会话，强调依赖旧配置前核对实际机器和平台，并说明不对不受支持配置作普遍隐形保证。

屏幕捕获和音频可能包含题目以外信息，使用私人材料前应确认服务和协作者收到什么。本文未测试屏幕共享、捕获排除、转录质量、数据保留政策或操作系统权限流程。隐形营销标签不能证明某场面试允许使用辅助。

sections.title_en: A small free allowance is not unlimited practice
sections.title_zh: 少量免费额度不等于无限练习
sections.en:
The homepage’s pricing section lists Free with three total usage credits and advertises paid monthly or lifetime access with1000 credits resetting each month. The actual paid purchase amounts and credit-per-action rules were not exposed in the retrieved text, so current payable pricing remains unverified. Confirm how transcript, AI answer, Duo and debrief actions consume allowance.

Do not equate a credit to a complete interview or interpret lifetime access as unlimited monthly use. The docs landing page was readable initially, but a later link-discovery request returned403; it was not retried. Refund, license, detailed retention and exact device requirements remain gaps.
sections.zh:
首页价格区列Free总共三次使用额度，并宣传付费月度或终身访问每月重置1000额度。已读文本未显示实际付费金额及每项操作消耗规则，因此当前可支付价格仍未核实。应确认转录、AI回答、Duo及复盘如何消耗额度。

不能将一个credit等同完整面试，也不能将终身访问理解为每月无限使用。文档入口最初可读，后续链接发现请求返回403，未重试。退款、许可、详细保留政策及准确设备要求仍待核。
